issue.title: Split repos.sidecar into builtin and custom buckets
issue.description: repos.sidecar is a two-bucket mapping (builtin for the reserved plans/beads/agents roles, custom for document sidecars such as research), keyed by role name, mirroring llm_provider.model_aliases; every enabled SASE project's config uses the new shape and the legacy list form is gone.

issue.title: Accept both shapes in the schema, parser, and doctor
issue.description: dual_read: teach the JSON schema, the sidecar config parser, the memory-generation validator, and the CI bootstrap tool to read the new builtin/custom mapping while still accepting the legacy list, and add a doctor check that reports the migration and mis-bucketed roles.

issue.title: Write and migrate every enabled project to the new shape
issue.description: migrate_configs: make sase repo init emit the two-bucket mapping, update the operator-facing guidance strings and docs examples, and migrate the sase, actstat, and bob-cli project configs to the new shape.

issue.title: Remove the legacy list form
issue.description: drop_legacy: delete the legacy list branch from the schema, parser, memory validator, and CI bootstrap tool so repos.sidecar is a closed builtin/custom object, and land it as a breaking change.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: `sase validate` fails on a clean master tree — `init memory --check` wants to update ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/sase/memory/README.md (+2 −2); pre-existing and unrelated to epic sase-gu.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: flaky test — tests/test_install_coverage_contexts_tool.py::test_installing_prunes_the_cache_to_the_keep_limit fails intermittently under the parallel `just test-scoped` lane but passes in isolation; likely shared coverage-context cache state across xdist workers.

dual_read complete. Schema: added sidecarRepoEntry (sidecarRepo minus name) and made repos.sidecar a oneOf of the new {builtin,custom} role-keyed object (propertyNames enforces reserved/non-reserved bucketing) and the deprecated list; default is now {} and default_config.yml ships sidecar: {builtin: {}, custom: {}}. Parser: new _sidecar_config_entries in _linked_repo_config.py reads both shapes, emitting builtin roles in canonical plans/beads/agents order then custom roles in configured order, custom winning a role declared in both; the {role,slug} token merge is retained for the legacy list. Raw readers updated: init_memory/config.py _sidecar_repos_raw now yields (label, role, entry) triples so mapping errors read repos.sidecar.custom['research'] while the list form keeps repos.sidecar[0] ('research'); tools/ci_bootstrap_sidecars plan_sidecars accepts both shapes. New doctor check config.repos (src/sase/doctor/checks_config_repos.py, registered in checks_config.py) reports the legacy list with each entry's target bucket, mis-bucketed/duplicated roles, leftover name: keys, non-mapping buckets/entries, and enabled lazy custom entries with no description. Re-grepped src/ and tools/ for REPOS_SIDECAR_CONFIG_KEY / repos.sidecar: the only remaining raw reader is _repo_init_config.explicit_sidecar_config_update, which migrate_configs owns. Tests added for both shapes across schema, parser ordering/layer-merge, doctor (one case per problem class), memory generation, and the CI tool; test_config_schema_rejects_invalid_sidecar_controls updated for the oneOf error shape. Verified: just install, just lint (ruff/mypy/symvision/toobig all clean), just test-scoped (26760 passed; one unrelated flake noted), sase doctor -C config.repos, and sase repo list showing unchanged sidecar rows. Two PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes recorded for the pre-existing sase validate memory-README failure and the flaky coverage-context test.

Dual-read sidecar config: schema oneOf (role-keyed builtin/custom map + deprecated legacy array), parser _sidecar_config_entries, init_memory and ci_bootstrap_sidecars raw readers, new config.repos doctor check. Verified with just install, just lint (ruff/mypy/symvision/toobig clean), just test-scoped (26760 passed), sase doctor -C config.repos, and sase repo list.

sase repo init now writes the role-keyed repos.sidecar mapping (builtin: plans/beads/agents, custom: research), refuses a legacy-list config with a migration error, and the agents consent prompt + docs/configuration.md + docs/init.md describe the two buckets. Migrated sase/sase.yml here and committed actstat (f63e496) and bob-cli (8bbef6e) in their own checkouts. Verified: just check-full green (all lint gates + full suite); workspace-venv sase doctor reports config.repos OK and 4 init planners current; sase repo list shows the same four sidecar rows in the same order for sase, actstat, and bob-cli; sase init memory --check reports nothing to regenerate, so AGENTS.md and its shims are unchanged; ~/.config/sase/sase.yml still has no repos.sidecar block (its only 'sidecars' key is an unrelated file_hooks entry).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: `just check-full` SASE validation fails pre-existing (unrelated to sase-gu) — `init memory --check` and `init skills --check` report drift in ~/.local/share/chezmoi/home (7 memory/shim files, 5 sase_gate SKILL.md files); confirmed identical on a stashed clean tree.

drop_legacy landed: schema oneOf array branch deleted and sidecarRepoEntry folded back into sidecarRepo (repos.sidecar is now a closed builtin/custom object); _sidecar_config_entries list branch and the {role,slug} token-intersection merge in _merged_sidecar_entries_cached removed along with the now-unused _sidecar_entry_tokens; init_memory _sidecar_repos_raw and tools/ci_bootstrap_sidecars _sidecar_entries now hard-error on a list; doctor config.repos legacy-list problem kept and reworded as a required migration; compatibility-window wording removed from docs/configuration.md and docs/init.md. Tests migrated to the mapping form across 10 modules; added schema + parser cases asserting the list form is now rejected/ignored. Verified: just fmt, then just check-full lint gates all pass (fmt py/md, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, symvision, toobig), validate-committed-plans passes, full suite 26899 passed / 7 skipped. 'sase doctor -C config.repos' reports OK and 'sase repo list' still shows agents, beads, plans, sase--research. The only check-full failure is SASE validation (init memory/skills chezmoi drift), confirmed pre-existing on a stashed clean tree and recorded as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Not committed — left for the epic land agent; plan asks for feat(repos)! with a BREAKING CHANGE footer.

LAND VERIFICATION (sase-gu.land).

Verified. Read all three phase beads and every note. Phase commits: 50bed7f99 (dual_read), f77bc9891 (migrate_configs), a56da1e6c (drop_legacy) — sase-gu.3's note said 'Not committed — left for the epic land agent', but the phase agent did in fact land it as feat(repos)! with the BREAKING CHANGE footer, so nothing was outstanding. Confirmed against source, not just reports: sase.schema.json's repos.sidecar is a closed object with builtin (propertyNames enum plans/beads/agents) and custom (propertyNames not-enum), sidecarRepoEntry is folded back into sidecarRepo and gone; _linked_repo_config._sidecar_config_entries reads only the mapping and emits builtin in canonical plans/beads/agents order then custom in configured order with custom winning a duplicate role; _merged_sidecar_entries_cached reduces to normalization with the {role,slug} token merge deleted; init_memory._sidecar_repos_raw yields (label, role, entry) triples and hard-errors on a list; tools/ci_bootstrap_sidecars._sidecar_entries raises BootstrapError on a list; doctor check config.repos exists and is registered in checks_config.py; default_config.yml ships sidecar: {builtin: {}, custom: {}}; docs/configuration.md and docs/init.md describe both buckets with the per-bucket field table and no compatibility-window wording. Re-grepped src/ and tools/ for repos.sidecar raw readers — none remain outside the parser, init_memory, ci_bootstrap_sidecars, the doctor check, and _repo_init_config's writer.

Migration confirmed at the source, not from phase reports: sase/sase.yml here plus actstat origin/master (f63e496) and bob-cli origin/master (8bbef6e) all carry the builtin/custom mapping with descriptions preserved. Only their ephemeral numbered workspaces are still behind, and those are refreshed at launch.

Integrated. Reviewed all 22 non-epic commits between 50bed7f99 and HEAD. Three touched sase.schema.json/default_config.yml (72148dcab notification tab icons, 317b83e72 statistics apostrophe selection, 0bea6801e markdown.print_width) but in unrelated sections; nothing else read or wrote repos.sidecar, and no landed change duplicates or conflicts with the bucket split. One integration gap found and fixed in commit 12c3e0a: _repo_init_config.explicit_sidecar_config_update still called the list form 'deprecated' in its operator-facing migration error — wording added during the compatibility window that drop_legacy did not update, now 'removed' to match the doctor check and the docs, with its test updated.

Verified at HEAD: just install, then just check — every lint gate green (fmt py/md, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, symvision, toobig) — and just test-scoped 26993 passed / 7 skipped. sase doctor -C config.repos reports OK. The one red gate is SASE validation / init skills --check reporting 5 stale sase_gate provider SKILL.md files under chezmoi; reproduced on a clean tree and unrelated to this epic (see follow-ups).

Follow-ups. Three PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries were collected across sase-gu.1 and sase-gu.3, and none became a new task.
1. sase validate / just check-full red from init skills --check chezmoi drift (sase-gu.1, sase-gu.3): duplicate of in-progress task sase-gw, which scopes exactly this check surface. Corroborated with a +1 carrying independent reproduction at a56da1e6c (same 5 sase_gate files, +12/-2, no local skill-source edits); sase-gw now has 2 independent reports. No new task.
2. The init memory --check half of the same proposals (sase-gu.1 saw chezmoi home/sase/memory/README.md; today it surfaced as project-local sase/memory/sase_beads.md +2 -3 and sase/memory/README.md +4 -4): declined as a task. A plain sase init memory cleared it with zero tracked-file changes in this repo or the chezmoi source, and init memory --check has been clean since, so there is no reproducible defect to file. Recorded on sase-gw's +1 so the distinction between the two check surfaces is not lost.
3. Flaky tests/test_install_coverage_contexts_tool.py::test_installing_prunes_the_cache_to_the_keep_limit (sase-gu.1): already fixed. Task sase-gl diagnosed it as cached_baselines sorting on a float st_mtime with no tie-break and closed at 14:33Z with commit aec67f31c, ~40 minutes after sase-gu.1 filed the proposal. Declined rather than +1'd because sase-gl is closed-done and a +1 would have reopened a resolved task as ready.

Correction to the land verification note above: the integration commit is 0f64fbe1b (fix(repos): call the list form of repos.sidecar removed, not deprecated), not 12c3e0a. Pushed to origin/master.

Also updated after that note was written: sase validate is now fully green, including init skills --check — the 5 stale sase_gate provider SKILL.md copies were redeployed to chezmoi out of band while this land ran, so the one red gate reported above no longer reproduces here. That does not retire sase-gw, whose scope is the check surface failing whenever deployed copies go stale rather than this particular instance, and the +1 evidence recorded there stands as an observed reproduction at a56da1e6c.
